chapter: Zulu, family and old New Orleans
title: The tune written for the King of the Zulus and the old Zulu parade
summary: Guesnon says he wrote a song for the Zulu king that was withdrawn, sings it, and describes how the Zulu parade once drew huge crowds.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
